title: Joltingly Crunchy Korean Tofu Bowl
description: Umami and crunchy Korean dish made with peppercorns and featuring ice-bath-shocked tofu, served in a cozy talavera plate.
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine soy sauce, rice vinegar, gochujang, and 2 cups of water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
While the sauce is cooking, cut the tofu into 1-inch cubes and place them in a large bowl.
Pour the sauce over the tofu and let it marinate for at least 30 minutes, flipping the tofu occasionally.
Just before serving, stir in 1 tsp of Korean chili flakes and 1 tsp of freshly cracked black peppercorns.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the marinated tofu. Cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until the tofu is golden brown and crispy.
While the tofu is cooking, prepare the ice bath by filling a large bowl with 2 cups of ice and 2 cups of water.
Once the tofu is cooked, transfer it to the ice bath to shock and stop the cooking process.
Let the tofu sit in the ice bath for 5-7 minutes, until it has cooled to room temperature.
To assemble the dish, place the ice-bath-shocked tofu on a talavera plate.
Sprinkle the crispy garlic, crushed sesame seeds, and green onions over the top of the tofu.
